# Narriv

> Narriv is a media monitoring and narrative intelligence platform for brands, agencies and public institutions in Indonesia. It monitors online news, YouTube, social media (Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook) and AI assistant answers about a brand every hour, scores the reputational risk, sends alerts to a named owner with a deadline, and produces board-ready reports. The interface is available in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

Narriv goes beyond social listening: instead of only collecting mentions, it groups them into narratives (issues), measures sentiment and how fast each issue grows, and turns that into decisions: who should act, what to do next, and by when.

## What Narriv does

- Hourly monitoring of online news and YouTube for every plan; Instagram, TikTok, X and Facebook from the Decision plan.
- Automatic sentiment analysis and issue (narrative) detection, including Indonesian-language content.
- Reputational risk score with the drivers behind it.
- Alerts with an owner and a deadline, sent by email; Slack, Microsoft Teams, webhooks and an escalation matrix on Decision and above.
- Daily brief and recommendations: what changed, what matters and the next step.
- Cases and response plans to track handling from detection to resolution.
- AI visibility: how AI assistants describe and recommend the brand.
- Ask Narriv: questions answered only from the workspace's own data, with the records cited.
- Reports in PDF, Excel, CSV and email, including scheduled weekly board reports, in English or Bahasa Indonesia.

## Who it is for

Corporate communications, PR, brand and reputation teams; agencies managing several clients; banks, telcos, ministries and public agencies that need early warning on issues and crises.

## Plans and pricing (IDR per month, excluding 11% VAT)

- Pilot: Rp 5,000,000. 1 brand, 3 keywords checked every hour, 1 user, 30-day data retention. News and YouTube, alerts, daily brief, Ask Narriv, PDF/Excel/email reports.
- Intelligence: Rp 25,000,000. 1 brand, 10 keywords, 10 users, 12-month retention. Adds AI visibility, scheduled board reports, cases and response plans.
- Decision: Rp 50,000,000. 3 brands, 25 keywords per brand, 50 users, 12-month retention. Adds Instagram, TikTok, X and Facebook, Slack/Teams/webhooks and an escalation matrix.
- Command: from Rp 100,000,000. Brands as needed, 50 keywords per brand, unlimited users, custom retention. Adds a dedicated success manager, quarterly strategy review and an SLA.
- Annual billing saves 20%. Payment is by bank transfer against an invoice.
- Free trial: 14 days on your own brand, 3 keywords checked hourly across online news and YouTube, every Pilot feature, no card needed. A live demo with sample data needs no sign-up.
